unfiltered_results.text:
Article: Admin Roles and Permissions During Migration
Section: Who Can Initiate or Confirm Migration

Only users with the **Billing Administrator** role can confirm a migration
that requires manual action. The **Account Owner** role can always confirm
migration, even if they do not also hold the Billing Administrator role.

Standard **Member** roles cannot see the migration banner and cannot confirm
migration, even if they have access to billing history.

Article: Billing Profile Migration — Complete Implementation Guide
Section: Operations Restricted During Migration

The following operations are not available while migration status is **in
progress**. Attempting these operations will return a `503 Migration in
Progress` error or a UI message asking you to try again later.

Article: Billing Profile Migration — Complete Implementation Guide
Section: Migration Status Notifications

### Email Notifications Sent Automatically

### In-App Banners

During the migration window, banners appear in the Billing Overview page:

- **Blue banner:** Migration is queued or in progress.
- **Green banner:** Migration completed successfully.
- **Red banner:** Migration failed. Includes the error code and a link to the
  remediation article.
- **Yellow banner:** Action required to unblock migration.
